product.name: Data Excellence
product.description: Data strategy, governance, maturity assessment, privacy, data management office support, engineering, exchange, and monetization services that help organizations manage data as a business asset.

product.name: Data Management
product.description: Services for organizing, integrating, managing, and governing enterprise data to improve accessibility, quality, and operational use.

product.name: Data Analytics
product.description: Analytics services that turn organizational data into insights for reporting, performance monitoring, forecasting, and operational decision-making.

product.name: Digital Transformation
product.description: Consulting and implementation services for modernizing business processes, customer experiences, and technology environments through digital solutions.

product.name: Cloud Excellence
product.description: Cloud services for planning, implementing, and improving cloud-based technology environments and digital workloads.

product.name: Business Management
product.description: Business management consulting and technology services that support organizational planning, execution, performance management, and operational improvement.
